originalText:
THIS GUY BUILT A FULL IPHONE APP WITH FABLE 5 BEFORE HIS USAGE CREDITS RAN OUT

an agency would've charged $25,000-$80,000 for this

Fable 5 did it in one session

the idea: a voice note transcription app for creative thinking

AI-analyzed transcripts. chat with your own notes. built from scratch

the setup:

> Fable 5 = orchestrator only, high effort, no escalation
> all implementation delegated to Opus sub-agents
> design first, architecture second - backwards from normal dev, but the design WAS the product

the workflow:

- mocked up glassmorphism UI in HTML/CSS - nailed it first try
- ran an A/B test vs Opus 4.8 - Opus was surprisingly good too
- extracted design tokens from the mockup into a shared theme
- ported everything to React Native pixel-for-pixel
- deployed straight to his phone via Expo + Apple Developer account

the difference:

Opus needed rounds and rounds of revisions

Fable just... got it, every piece of feedback, executed correctly the first time

from idea to working iPhone app, one session

have you tried building anything with Fable 5 yet?
